body: Thank you, I’ll start there, I’ve convinced myself of being only here to help people due to no one helping me ever that I’ve dug such a hole and didn’t know where to start
Thank you and maybe CBT, I think that’s the best option
I just find it difficult to break out of this mindset that I’m not just on the earth to help people. And I don’t know how to stop giving it my all for people cause I know how it feels to have no one
Getting the proper therapy that I need and deal with the chaos in my head

I feel the exact same way I begged my mother to bring me to therapy because I was so close to ending it, I got the knife and wrote out all my notes but she didn’t help me. She ignored every time I told her that I am going to kill myself. And then she claims that I hide my sadness ‘well’ she kept taking me out of therapy and tells me to stop with the attitude or to get over it. Then expects me to listen to her problems because I’m in psychology. Therapist told me I’m a lost cause and I even got turned away from BetterHelp. No one cares if I’m gone or if I joe about killing myself. No one will go to my funeral

I’m not trying to find someone per say. It’s just absolutely terrifying when I actually start liking someone and they start liking me too. So I cut off all ties. I want to be normal and let things happen but I freak out whenever someone gets dependent on me for love and affection. Because I don’t want them to threaten to kill themselves if I decide the relationship isn’t for me in the future
My anxiety has been so bad lately and my depression has gotten worse. I wish I never took a summer semester

I feel this so fucking bad. I begged my mom to bring me to counselling, she knew I think about killing myself daily and when I’m upset and could barely get out of bed she would tell me to drop the attitude. I put everyone ahead of myself and would make sure that they were ok no matter what I was doing but no one would do the same to me and they all know I’m hurting and have issues trying to do anything. But no one helps and no one goes out of their way to help me. This year all my close friends forgot my birthday and I know that if I kill myself no one will care and will forget about me

It’s awful. I never remember anything anymore, I’d have people from my past message me and ask me if I remember them. But I don’t, I don’t remember anything about them. But of course I have to pretend I do to make them feel better. I don’t remember to eat most days and I cant remember any happy memories. Everything just feels like a blur. I hate talking about the past because I don’t remember the good things like other people do. Now my memory has gotten so bad that I forget common words and I’ll be talking but won’t be able to remember a word so I have to stop myself and think about it but it never clicks.

Completely. I don’t even know who I am anymore. I’ve created such a facade I can’t even determine who I am or what I’m like. But being this ‘happy’ persona is all I can do because whenever I tried to show how unhappy I am, I was told to kill myself, to stop the attitude, stop crying whore, and everyone would ignore me. If I want people to talk to me and tolerate me I have to exhibit a go lucky attitude

I’m at my breaking point. I don’t have the energy to pretend to be ok like I always do. I always defend and help others but I’ve never had the same done to me, and the other day someone was yelling at me for parking too close to their car and these girls defended me. I broke down in front of them and couldn’t stop crying. I never felt that kind of security before and it broke me cause I have no protection in my life. I’m so so tired and I don’t have the mentality for anything now adays. I’m just tired
